stories.headline: Simile Raises $200M Series B at a $2 Billion Valuation to Replace Focus Groups With AI 'Twins'
stories.key_takeaway: Simile, founded by the Stanford researchers behind generative agents, raised over $200M at a $2B valuation to sell AI 'agentic twins' that simulate real consumers, patients and employees in place of focus groups and surveys.

pull_quote.text: If you're able to simulate the world, you can basically test out countless interventions.

data_points.label: Agentic twins used by CVS Health

stories.article_excerpt: A startup wants companies to stop asking real people what they think, and start asking fake ones instead.

stories.headline: AMD's Q2 Lands With AI Data-Center Revenue in Focus After Its Anthropic Bet
stories.key_takeaway: AMD posted record Q2 2026 revenue of $11.5B with data-center sales up 107%, but shares fell nearly 9% after hours as a high AI bar and softer margins outweighed a clear beat.

pull_quote.text: We delivered an excellent quarter, with record revenue and profitability as Data Center revenue more than doubled year-over-year.

stories.article_excerpt: AMD delivered exactly the kind of quarter it needed to justify a soaring stock and a headline-grabbing bet on Anthropic.

stories.headline: Palantir's Q2 Blowout: Revenue Jumps 93% as AI Demand Fuels Its Largest-Ever Guidance Raise
stories.key_takeaway: Palantir's 93% revenue jump and largest-ever guidance raise, powered by 149% U.S. commercial growth, show enterprise AI demand is converting into real, accelerating revenue at scale.

pull_quote.text: The sovereign AI revolution makes us very optimistic about the future.

stories.article_excerpt: Palantir Technologies did not just beat Wall Street in the second quarter. It rewrote the pace at which a company scales.

stories.headline: Spotify Adds Merlin's 30,000 Labels to Its AI Covers and Remixes Push
stories.key_takeaway: Spotify has enlisted Merlin's 30,000-plus independent labels alongside Universal Music Group behind its upcoming consent-based, paid AI covers and remixes tool, signaling the music industry's decisive shift from litigating generative AI to licensing it.

pull_quote.text: Normal generative music will happen with or without us. This product will not happen without us, and it needs to exist so that existing artists can participate in this.

data_points.label: Stock decline from 52-week high into earnings

stories.article_excerpt: Spotify used its second-quarter earnings call on Tuesday to widen the coalition behind its most closely watched product.

stories.headline: SoftBank's Earnings Test Investor Appetite for Its AI Bets Beyond OpenAI
stories.key_takeaway: SoftBank's Q1 earnings will test whether its robotics, data-center and energy bets can justify the heavy leverage behind its roughly $65 billion OpenAI stake as an IPO delay squeezes financing.

pull_quote.text: Stargate is harnessing SoftBank's innovative data center design and energy expertise to deliver the scalable compute that powers AI's future.

stories.article_excerpt: When SoftBank Group reports fiscal first-quarter results in Tokyo on Thursday, the numbers on the page will matter.

stories.headline: Microsoft Open-Sources Orchard, the 'Missing Layer' of the AI Agent Stack
stories.key_takeaway: Microsoft open-sourced Orchard, an environment-layer framework for training and evaluating AI agents inside real deployment harnesses, completing a year-long push to build an open agent stack.

pull_quote.text: The central idea behind Orchard is that the runtime environment should be a standalone, reusable service rather than infrastructure embedded inside a specific training framework.

data_points.label: Orchard-SWE on SWE-bench Verified (~3B active params)
Released via GitHub and Hugging Face

stories.article_excerpt: When Microsoft Research quietly pushed a repository called Orchard to GitHub this week, the AI trade press took notice.

stories.headline: Google's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Hits General Availability, and Its 'Spark' Agent Learns to Drive Chrome
stories.key_takeaway: Google moved the core of its Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to general availability with per-agent identity and multi-day state, while consumer agent Gemini Spark gained the ability to operate desktop Chrome using saved logins.

pull_quote.text: Agent Runtime has been a massive accelerator, allowing us to deploy a sophisticated multi-agent architecture that increases digital containment while ensuring secure, grounded interactions via Gemini.

data_points.label: Countries in Spark AI Pro expansion

stories.article_excerpt: Google Cloud this week moved the core of its Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform into general availability.

stories.headline: Crogl Releases a Free Autonomous 'AI SOC Agent' for Security Teams
stories.key_takeaway: Crogl has made its autonomous AI SOC agent a free, minutes-to-deploy download, using a product-led go-to-market to push agentic security operations into mainstream enterprise use.

pull_quote.text: The debate around AI for security operations shouldn't be settled by marketing. It should be settled by practitioners.

data_points.label: Daily security alerts enterprises actually investigate
Time to install and connect to a SIEM

stories.article_excerpt: Most security software takes months to buy and weeks to install. Crogl wants to be running before you finish coffee.

stories.headline: Nvidia Builds an Open Foundation for Surgical Robots With Open-H Video and Cosmos-H Synthetic Worlds
stories.key_takeaway: Nvidia has open-sourced a physical-AI stack for surgical robotics that pairs the largest open dataset of real surgical video (Open-H) with a generative synthetic-data engine (Cosmos-H), letting device makers train and validate robots in simulation before they touch patients.

pull_quote.text: The next generation of surgical robotics will be powered by data, simulation and AI working together.
pull_quote.role: Head of Healthcare Business Development, NVIDIA

data_points.label: 600 policy rollouts vs ~2 days on hardware

stories.article_excerpt: The hardest thing about teaching a robot to operate on a person is that you cannot afford to let it practice on one.

stories.headline: A New Protein-Design Model, Proteina-Complexa, Generates Binders Validated Against 130+ Targets
stories.key_takeaway: NVIDIA's Proteina-Complexa pairs a reasoning-style generative model with inference-time compute to design roughly one million protein binders that were experimentally validated against more than 130 targets, hitting 68% of them.

pull_quote.text: This study provides a practical demonstration of scaling laws in de novo protein design, with more designs producing more hits.

stories.article_excerpt: For decades, designing a protein that reliably grabs onto a chosen target was a slow, artisanal craft.

stories.headline: As AI Agents Proliferate, a Sweeping Survey Maps How We Actually Evaluate Them
stories.key_takeaway: A SAP Labs survey argues that agent evaluation, not raw capability, is now the bottleneck for safely deploying autonomous AI agents, and offers a two-dimensional taxonomy to organize a fragmented field.

pull_quote.text: We highlight enterprise-specific challenges, such as role-based access to data, the need for reliability guarantees, dynamic and long-horizon interactions, and compliance, which are often overlooked in current research.
pull_quote.role: Evaluation and Benchmarking of LLM Agents: A Survey

stories.article_excerpt: The AI industry spent 2025 and 2026 racing to ship autonomous agents. Measuring them is another matter.

stories.headline: Teaching AI Agents to Go the Distance: 'KLong' Targets Extremely Long-Horizon Tasks
stories.key_takeaway: KLong trains a 106B open-source agent to reliably complete extremely long-horizon tasks via trajectory-splitting SFT and progressive RL, beating a 1T model on PaperBench.

pull_quote.text: We observe that the running time and assistant turns of the extremely long-horizon task are approximately 10 times that of the long-horizon task.

stories.article_excerpt: Ask a large language model to fix a typo and it rarely stumbles. Ask it to reproduce an entire experiment, and it wanders.

stories.headline: The FTC's New AI Accuracy Doctrine: Secretly 'Steering' a Model Could Be Illegal Deception
stories.key_takeaway: The FTC's proposed policy statement treats undisclosed 'steering' of AI outputs as likely deception under Section 5 and asserts that conflicting state AI laws like Colorado's are impliedly preempted, escalating the federal-vs-state fight.

pull_quote.text: The FTC wants to hear from businesses and consumers about their experiences and concerns regarding the subversion of AI systems for ideological ends.

stories.article_excerpt: Bury the fact that your chatbot has been tuned to push a particular answer, and you may be breaking federal law.

stories.headline: Colorado's Landmark AI Act Stalls Again as a Court Delays Enforcement
stories.key_takeaway: A federal court paused enforcement of Colorado's first-in-the-nation AI discrimination law after xAI sued and the DOJ intervened, and the statute was then repealed and replaced by a weaker disclosure regime amid a widening federal preemption fight.

pull_quote.text: It is really problematic, it needs to be fixed.

stories.article_excerpt: The first comprehensive state law in the country meant to police algorithmic discrimination was supposed to be a template.

stories.headline: Dili Raises $15M Series A to Automate Wage Monitoring and Payroll Compliance With AI
stories.key_takeaway: Dili raised a $15M Series A led by Khosla Ventures to replace human-sampled payroll audits with AI that reviews 100% of prevailing-wage and certified-payroll data in real time for infrastructure projects.

pull_quote.text: Compliance in this industry has always meant hoping the sample your auditor pulled happens to be clean. We look at everything, every report, every wage determination, every week.

stories.article_excerpt: For decades, proving that America's biggest construction projects paid workers fairly came down to a spot check.
